name: invoices-functions
description: Root configuration to delegate Firebase emulator and helper scripts

scripts.dev: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project=icy-invoices --import=./exported-dev-data --export-on-exit=./exported-dev-data
scripts.pro: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project=icy-invoices --import=./exported-pro-data --export-on-exit=./exported-pro-data
scripts.shell: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase functions:shell
